summary: Institutional positioning is characterized by massive, long-dated hedging and directional bets on extreme SPX volatility, evidenced by $15.6B in SPX premium and a high P/C ratio of 1.64. There is significant directional conviction in "strangle-like" accumulation, specifically massive buying of SPX 7000C and 8000P strikes expiring in late 2026, totaling billions in premium. Persistent multi-day interest is highly concentrated in the SPX 7000C (exp 2026-09-18) and 8000P (exp 2026-09-18) positions, which have seen billions in accumulation over the last 4 sessions. Traders should watch for extreme SPX volatility expansion or a massive "volatility crush" if the underlying fails to move toward these far-out-of-the-money targets, as the sheer scale of these 2026 LEAPS suggests institutions are positioning for a massive macro-regime shift.
